headlines.title: Sec. Duffy says ‘I can’t apologize’ for decades-old air traffic control infrastructure
headlines.description: Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy tells Meet the Press he hopes Congress will take up bipartisan legislation to allocate more money for new FAA systems after a router upgrade disruption caused a nationwide ground stop.

headlines.title: Scott Colom: ‘I’m not here to look out for the billionaires’
headlines.description: After a historic win in Mississippi, Sen.-elect Scott Colom (D) discusses his campaign promise of restoring affordability in his state.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola is likely to win Alaska’s Senate race, as vote counting continues
headlines.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola is likely to win Alaska’s Senate race, according to an NBC News Decision Desk analysis, as vote-counting continues in the state.

headlines.title: Women with autoimmune diseases often misdiagnosed for 4 years or more
headlines.description: Women with autoimmune diseases such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis are more likely to be misdiagnosed or get delayed treatment compared with men, with their symptoms often dismissed as “psychological.”

headlines.title: Bowen Yang returns to ‘SNL’ to spoof Jensen Huang amid Nvidia spy scandal
headlines.description: Former “Saturday Night Live” repertory player and writer Bowen Yang returned to help open the show this weekend with his portrayal of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

headlines.title: Could a viral teen comedy be Netflix’s answer to YouTube?
headlines.description: Netflix is hoping Gen Z audiences stream “Minimum Wage,” which began as a web series in 2024.

headlines.title: Two people injured after taxiing planes collide at Miami International Airport
headlines.description: Two taxiing planes collided at Miami International Airport on Saturday night, officials said, a day after a nationwide ground stop disrupted flights across the country.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Scott Colom says investing in the South can help Democrats win ‘a durable majority’
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Scott Colom, D-Miss., emphasized in that Democrats need to invest more in southern states like Mississippi, where he flipped the seat blue for the first time in decades.
